title: Roles of Hepatic Insufficiency, Hepatic Fibrosis, and Inorganic Pyrophosphate in the Progression of Arterial Calcifications
official: Roles of Hepatic Insufficiency, Hepatic Fibrosis, and Inorganic Pyrophosphate in the Progression of Arterial Calcifications
summary: Individuals with metabolic syndrome (MetS), particularly those with type 2 diabetes (T2D), and/or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis or MASH face an elevated risk of major cardiovascular events (MACE). We showed decrease plams level of PPi in patients with liver cirrhosis. We hypothezised that liver transplant should block AC and restore PPi plasma level.
